# Game-TCP-Speed v3.0

> Game-TCP-Speed is an open-source, ultra-lightweight pure Win32 process-level TCP network game accelerator for Windows. It provides millisecond-level traffic tunneling without TUN/TAP virtual network adapters, WebView bloat, or system gateway routing conflicts.

## Project Overview

- Repository: https://github.com/fun3588/game-tcp-speed
- Primary Architecture: Pure Win32 API + GDI (Native Hook DLL + Native Windows Common Controls)
- Core Hook Engine: Winsock Inline Hooking (`connect`, `WSAConnect`, `ConnectEx`, `WSAIoctl`) via MinHook x64
- Dedicated Tunnel: Sing-box TCP stream proxy (AnyTLS + Reality)
- Target Use Case: Low-latency, jitter-free cross-border game acceleration (e.g., World of Warcraft, Diablo, FFXIV) without interfering with local developer environments (Docker, WSL2, corporate VPNs).
- Legacy Archived: Previous C# WPF GUI archived under `c#/GameTcpSpeed.Wpf`.

## Key Technical Details in v3.0

- Ultra-Low Footprint: Only 3 ~ 5 MB RAM, single binary 174 KB, starts in < 0.01s. Zero WebView2 or .NET CLR runtime dependencies.
- Zero TUN Adapter: Operates purely in user space. No virtual NIC or system routing table modifications.
- Live Process Takeover: Hooks asynchronous IOCP `ConnectEx` to accelerate already-running games without requiring a restart.
- Clean Remote Ejection: Supports on-the-fly `FreeLibrary` unhooking to immediately restore direct connectivity without exiting the game.
- Non-Blocking Socket Preservation: Automatically restores non-blocking socket modes (`ioctlsocket`, `WSAEventSelect`, `WSAAsyncSelect`) and emits `FD_CONNECT` / `SetEvent` signals to prevent game main-thread freezes.
- Bilingual Support: Instant runtime dynamic switching between Simplified Chinese and English (<1ms).
- Real-Time Network Probe: Host-to-game physical RTT measurements.
- Game Directory Auto-Detection: Automatically discovers local game config (`WTF\Config.wtf`) and loads target realm endpoints.
- Subscription Persistence: Automatically saves custom subscriptions to `subscription.ini`.

## Key Files & Documentation

- [README.md](https://github.com/fun3588/game-tcp-speed/blob/main/README.md): Comprehensive project architecture and usage guide (Chinese & English).
- [setupAnytls.md](https://github.com/fun3588/game-tcp-speed/blob/main/setupAnytls.md): Automated server deployment script and low-latency network tuning guidelines.
- [ai.md](https://github.com/fun3588/game-tcp-speed/blob/main/ai.md): Maintenance guidelines and architectural invariants for AI assistants.
